# Sam Mézec

Sam Mézec is the current Deputy of [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). He was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Sam Mézec has participated in 5 elections since 2002:

- [**2014 St Helier No 2 Deputy By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec#e44)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 52.5% of the vote.
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 50.4% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/sam-mezec-3/)
  - [2014 SOS Jersey Q&A](http://sosjersey.co.uk/election-special-2014-what-they-said/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=02-cvbGh1QA)
- [**2016 Senator By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec#e22)

  Not elected.

  - [2016 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2016/sam-mezec-2/)
  - [2016 Full Manifesto](https://docs.wixstatic.com/ugd/142c48_151e9b8a73cb4081a20c6fe5fcc9591c.pdf)
  - [2016 SOS Jersey Q&A](http://sosjersey.co.uk/jerseys-senatorial-by-election-2016-qs-as/)
  - [2016 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d7hhSaoZ5tQ)
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec#e41)

  Elected as Senator with 40.7% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/sam-mezec-4/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FBMRdP3m9Bo)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0SZD_jbnEu4)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy-2018-sammezec/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 6 with 54.2% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/sam-mezec/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-R1X1EyG5kI)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Sam-Mezec-Deputy-St-Helier-South-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)

Sam Mézec has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/05/reform-jersey-leader-to-stand-for-senator/)\]

## Election History

### 2014 St Helier No 2 Deputy By-Election

Following the loss of a libel action regarding a satirical cartoon, Trevor Pitman and Shona Pitman were disqualified from the States in January 2014 after being declared bankrupt (1 seat), 5th March 2014.

**Sam Mézec was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 in 2014**.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Sam Mézec** | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 277 | 52.5% |
| 2 | [Ian Philpot](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-philpot) |  | 99 | 18.8% |
| 3 | [Bernard Manning](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning) |  | 87 | 16.5% |
| 4 | [Paul Huelin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-huelin) |  | 65 | 12.3% |

528 votes

3,771 registered voters
